experiences.name: Maruyama Park Cherry Blossom Viewing
experiences.description: Visit Kyoto's most famous cherry blossom spot during peak bloom. The park features hundreds of sakura trees including a magnificent weeping cherry tree at its center. Ideal for families with open spaces for picnics and evening illuminations. Since your flight arrives late on Day 1, plan this from Day 2 onward during morning or afternoon hours to maximize daylight and energy after travel.

experiences.name: Tsukiji Outer Market Food Tour
experiences.description: Explore Tokyo's iconic Tsukiji Outer Market with a guided family-friendly food tour sampling fresh sushi, tamagoyaki, matcha treats, and street snacks. A fantastic cultural and culinary immersion that introduces Japanese food traditions to all ages. Schedule this on Day 2 or later as Day 1 arrival is late evening, leaving no time for evening food tours.
experiences.location: Tsukiji Outer Market, Chuo City, Tokyo

experiences.name: Hiroshima Peace Memorial Museum and Park
experiences.description: A deeply moving and historically significant experience for families. The museum documents the events of 1945 with age-appropriate exhibits, while the Peace Memorial Park offers reflective walks and the iconic Atomic Bomb Dome. Encourages meaningful conversations about history and peace. Best visited mid-morning to allow ample time before closing.
experiences.location: Peace Memorial Park, Naka Ward, Hiroshima

experiences.name: Asakusa Temple and Traditional Craft Workshop
experiences.description: Visit the iconic Senso-ji Temple in Asakusa, Tokyo's oldest temple, followed by a family-friendly hands-on workshop in traditional Japanese crafts such as origami or furoshiki wrapping. Combines cultural immersion with interactive activities suitable for children and adults alike. Avoid scheduling on Day 1 due to late arrival — begin from Day 2.

experiences.name: Arashiyama Bamboo Grove and Monkey Park
experiences.description: Explore the ethereal bamboo groves of Arashiyama and visit the Iwatayama Monkey Park where families can interact with Japanese macaques while enjoying panoramic views of Kyoto. A perfect blend of nature, culture, and family fun. The grove is best experienced in the morning before crowds arrive. Since Day 1 is a late arrival, this is best planned from Day 2 onward.
